name: skill-conductor
description: Design, evaluate, improve, port, and package high-quality agent Skills across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and other compatible agent hosts

interface.longDescription: Turns a task, workflow, prompt, SOP, or existing Skill into a portable agent Skill. It designs the architecture before writing, defines a host-neutral Skill Contract, calibrates freedom by consequence, builds trigger and negative-trigger coverage, runs structural and behavioral evaluation, pressure-tests brittle rules, compares candidates against held-out cases, compiles host adapters only where necessary, and prepares installable Skill packages without pretending unexecuted tests passed.
defaultPrompt: Design a production-quality Skill for this workflow and prove why the Skill is needed.
Audit this Skill for triggering, instruction quality, portability, and regression risk.
Convert this workflow into a portable Skill for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, and compatible agents.
